items.reason: The PR adds rejected addresses to an array that is never cleared (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/create_account_controller.js:275), and cached matches fail validation at line 69, disabling submission at line 22. Removing the server rule would allow validation again (app/models/blocked_email.rb:12–18), but editing the input or reopening the modal does not invalidate the client cache. This prevents retrying the now-valid address until the page is reloaded.
